Government of India ‘
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions:
d Department of Personne! & Training

Kartavya Bhawan-3, New Delhi
Dated 8th June, 2026

Subject: Representation for pay fixation in the light of IPS (Pay) Amendment
Rules, 2023 — reg.

The undersigned is directed to refer to Ministry of Home Affairs’ OM No.
16011/07/2024-1PS-Il dated 19.05.2028, vide which, the request has been made to
relax the prescribed time limit for exercising the option and provide another
opportunity to (PS officers who want to re-exercise the option for pay fixation in
light of IPS(Pay) Amendment Rules, 2023 notified on 05.12.2023, as a special
case. ]

2. The matter has been examined in this Department in light ofthe extant
provisions and reasons/circumstances furnished by MHA. Accordingly, it has been
decided to grant a further one-time extension of three months from the date of
issuance of this Office Memorandum for exercising/re-exercising the option for pay
fixation under the IPS (Pay) Amendment Rules, 2023 in respect, of the concerned +
IPS officers. It is further conveyed that no further request for extension of time
or relaxation of conditidns for exercising/re-exercising the option shall be
entertained under any circumstances. Accordingly, MHA may take further
necessary action in the matter.
3. This issues with the approval of the compatent authority.

x)
(RK Yadav)
Under Secretary to the Government of India

The Under Secretary (IPS-11),
Ministry of Home Affairs,
